definition_en: a sign that shows an illness or a deeper problem
core_image: 体温计上的水银升到红色刻度，医生记下这笔
scene: 发烧是感染的常见症状。Fever is a common symptom of infection.
sceneCN: 这里 symptom 是「症状」（第 1 个义项）；句意：发烧是感染的常见症状。

senses.title: A sign of illness
senses.definition: a change in the body that shows a disease
senses.definitionCN: 显示疾病的身体变化
senses.example: Fever is a common symptom of infection.
senses.exampleCN: 发烧是感染的常见症状。
senses.why: The Greek word meant a chance happening that falls together with something else.
senses.whyCN: 这个希腊词意为与某事同时发生的偶然现象。

senses.title: A sign of a wider problem
senses.definition: a sign that something else is wrong
senses.definitionCN: 表明其他方面出了问题的迹象
senses.example: Rising debt is a symptom of deeper trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 债务上升是更深层问题的征兆。
senses.why: If a bodily sign can point to a disease, any sign can point to a hidden cause.
senses.whyCN: 身体迹象可以指向疾病，任何迹象也就能指向隐藏的根源。

intro.en: Symptom comes from Greek symptoma, something that falls together.
intro.cn: symptom 源自希腊语 symptoma，意为同时发生之事。

items.en: Symptoma meant a chance event falling with another.
items.cn: symptoma 意为与另一事同时发生的偶然事件。

items.en: Piptein meant to fall.
items.cn: piptein 意为落下。

items.en: Symptoma became a medical term for a sign of disease.
items.cn: symptoma 成为指疾病迹象的医学术语。

items.en: French symptome carried the medical sense to English.
items.cn: 法语 symptome 把医学含义带入英语。

items.en: Symptom widened to signs of any deeper problem.
items.cn: symptom 扩展到任何深层问题的迹象。

note.en: Symptom is compared with look-alike words and with other signs.
note.cn: 把 symptom 与形近词以及其他表示迹象的词作比较。

definition_en: the combining of separate parts into a whole, or the whole that results
core_image: 长桌上摊着十几张卡片，颜色相同的被归成一叠，最后连成一条完整的故事线
scene: 资料室的长桌上摊着十几张卡片，学生把颜色相同的归成一叠，再按线索连成一条完整的故事线。Synthesis came only after the scattered notes were grouped and read as one account.
sceneCN: 这里 synthesis 指「把分散的部分合为一个整体」（第 1 个义项：综合）；句意为只有把散乱的笔记归类并读成一份完整叙述之后，综合才发生。

pos.zh: 综合；合成；综合体；合题（复数形式不走常规英语规则，而沿用希腊式变化）

derivatives.zh: 合成；综合（名词加表「使成为」的动词后缀）
合成的；人造的（希腊形容词后缀，指「由组合而成」）
合成器；综合者（动词加表施动者或器具的后缀）
以合成方式（形容词加副词后缀）

senses.title: Combining parts into a whole
senses.definition: the act of bringing separate elements together so that they form one coherent thing
senses.definitionCN: 把彼此分离的要素合到一起，形成一件连贯之物的行为
senses.example: Synthesis came only after the scattered notes were grouped and read as one account.
senses.exampleCN: 只有把散乱的笔记归类并读成一份完整叙述之后，综合才发生。
senses.why: The Greek noun means 'a putting together', and its verb means 'to place' — the image is literally placing side by side.
senses.whyCN: 希腊名词意为「放到一起」，其动词意为「放置」——画面就是字面上的并排摆放。

senses.title: Chemical synthesis
senses.definition: the building of a compound from simpler substances in a controlled reaction
senses.definitionCN: 在受控反应中由较简单物质构建化合物
senses.example: The synthesis of the dye takes four steps and a cold bath.
senses.exampleCN: 这种染料的合成需要四步和一个冰浴。
senses.why: Chemistry takes the literal meaning: separate substances are placed together and made to combine.
senses.whyCN: 化学取了字面义：分离的物质被放到一起并被迫结合。

senses.title: The composite result
senses.definition: the whole produced by combining, considered as a thing in its own right
senses.definitionCN: 由组合产生的整体，被当作独立存在之物
senses.example: The novel is a synthesis of two very different traditions.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说是两种极不相同传统的综合体。
senses.why: A verb of making yields a noun that can name what was made, not only the making.
senses.whyCN: 表「制作」的动词产出的名词，既能指制作，也能指所制之物。

senses.title: The Hegelian synthesis
senses.definition: in dialectical philosophy, the higher stage that reconciles a thesis and its opposite
senses.definitionCN: 在辩证哲学中，调和正题与其对立面的更高阶段
senses.example: The argument moves from thesis to antithesis to synthesis.
senses.exampleCN: 论证从正题走到反题，再走到合题。
senses.why: Philosophy borrowed the word for a resolution that keeps what was true in both earlier stages.
senses.whyCN: 哲学借这个词指一种保留前两阶段中真东西的解决。

senses.title: A synthesis essay
senses.definition: a piece of writing that combines several sources into one supported position
senses.definitionCN: 把若干来源合成一个有依据立场的写作
senses.example: The exam asks for a synthesis of three provided articles.
senses.exampleCN: 这场考试要求综合所提供的三篇文章。
senses.why: Writing instruction took the word for making a whole and applied it to an exercise that must weld sources together.
senses.whyCN: 写作教学把这个表示「造出整体」的词，用到一项必须把来源焊合起来的练习上。

senses.title: Speech synthesis
senses.definition: the artificial production of speech from text or symbols
senses.definitionCN: 由文字或符号人工生成语音
senses.example: Modern synthesis makes a recorded voice sound almost human.
senses.exampleCN: 现代语音合成让录制的声音听起来几乎像真人。
senses.why: Engineering extends the act to sound: separate phonemes are placed in order until a voice is built.
senses.whyCN: 工程把这动作扩展到声音上：分离的音素被按序放好，直到造出一个嗓音。

senses.title: Biological synthesis in cells
senses.definition: the building of a substance by a living cell from simpler materials
senses.definitionCN: 活细胞由较简单材料构建物质
senses.example: Protein synthesis begins at the ribosome.
senses.exampleCN: 蛋白质合成从核糖体开始。
senses.why: The cell performs the chemist's act at a smaller scale, and the word needs no change of form.
senses.whyCN: 细胞在更小的尺度上做化学家所做的事，而这个词无需改变形式。

senses.title: A level in a learning taxonomy
senses.titleCN: 综合层级（教育目标分类）
senses.definition: in education, the stage at which a learner builds something new from existing knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 在教育中，学习者用已有知识造出新东西的阶段
senses.example: The task sits at the synthesis level of the old taxonomy.
senses.exampleCN: 这项任务处在旧分类体系的综合层级。
senses.why: A curriculum made the act into a measurable stage, so a verb of building became a place on a ladder.
senses.whyCN: 一套课程把这个动作变成可测的阶段，于是表「构建」的动词成了阶梯上的一格。

intro.en: Synthesis is a Greek noun meaning 'a putting together', taken into English through Latin. Its parts are the same pieces that build thesis and hypothesis.
intro.cn: synthesis 是希腊名词，意为「放到一起」，经拉丁语进入英语。它的组成部分与构成 thesis 和 hypothesis 的是同样的碎片。

items.en: The verb meant 'to place, put, set'. It is the same placing verb that appears in thesis and in hypothesis.
items.cn: 这个动词意为「放置、摆、设立」。它就是出现在 thesis 与 hypothesis 里的那个「放置」动词。

items.en: The prefix meant 'together, with'. It appears in dozens of Greek compounds that English later borrowed.
items.cn: 这个前缀意为「一起、共同」。它出现在数十个后来被英语借入的希腊复合词中。

items.en: The noun meant 'a putting together, a composition'. It could name a compound object as well as the act of compounding.
items.cn: 这个名词意为「放到一起、组合」。它既能指被组合的物，也能指组合的行为。

items.en: Latin borrowed the noun with the same sense, and it also named a kind of composite garment; the borrowing is learned rather than native.
items.cn: 拉丁语以同样的意义借入这个名词，也用它指一种拼接式的衣服；这是书面借词，而非本族构词。

items.en: English used the word for logical composition first, and chemistry adopted it once the modern science took shape.
items.cn: 英语最初用它指逻辑上的组合，现代科学成形后化学采用了它。

items.en: Twentieth-century biology, computing and education each gave the word a fixed place. Source uncertain: the deeper origin of the placing verb is a reconstructed form.
items.cn: 20 世纪的生物学、计算与教育学各自给了这个词一个固定位置。来源不确定：那个「放置」动词的更早来源属重构形式。

note.en: The first group holds words built from the same Greek placing verb; the second holds near neighbours for combining.
note.cn: 第一组是由同一个希腊「放置」动词构成的词；第二组是表示「结合」的近义词。

entries.definition: Same placing verb without the 'together' prefix: a statement set down, hence a proposition or a long research essay.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个「放置」动词但不带「一起」前缀：被放下的陈述，因此指论点或长篇研究论文。

entries.definition: The prefix means 'under': something placed beneath as a basis, hence a provisional explanation.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀意为「在下」：作为基础被放在下面的东西，因此指暂定的解释。

entries.definition: The prefix means 'against': the counter-statement that a synthesis is said to reconcile.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀意为「相对」：那个据说被合题调和的反面陈述。

entries.definition: It describes what has been combined, or what is artificial; it never names the act of combining.
entries.definitionCN: 形容已被组合的东西，或人造之物；它从不指组合这一行为。

entries.definition: It says only that things are joined; it makes no claim that the result is coherent.
entries.definitionCN: 只说明事物被接在一起，不主张结果连贯。

entries.tag: parts made to work as one
entries.definition: It stresses that the joined parts function together, often of systems or groups.
entries.definitionCN: 强调接起来的各部分共同运作，常用于系统或群体。

entries.definition: It implies the parts lose their separate identity, which synthesis does not require.
entries.definitionCN: 暗示各部分失去独立身份，而 synthesis 不要求如此。

entries.definition: It names the resulting object as a thing with visible parts, not the process.
entries.definitionCN: 指结果之物，强调其各部分仍可见，而非指过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek parts mean 'together' plus 'place': synthesis is placing things together.
normal.cn: 希腊成分意为「一起」加「放置」：synthesis 就是把东西放到一起。

normal.en: The family runs synthesis, synthesize, synthetic, synthesizer, synthetically.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 synthesis、synthesize、synthetic、synthesizer、synthetically。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: chemical synthesis, protein synthesis, speech synthesis.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：化学合成、蛋白质合成、语音合成。

normal.en: The same placing verb gives thesis, hypothesis and antithesis with other prefixes.
normal.cn: 同一个「放置」动词配上别的前缀，给出 thesis、hypothesis、antithesis。

normal.en: The plural is Greek in shape, so the second syllable changes rather than gaining a simple ending.
normal.cn: 复数按希腊式变化，因此变的是第二个音节，而不是简单加一个词尾。

abstract.en: Picture two colours mixed until a third appears that neither contained.
abstract.cn: 想象两种颜色调出一种两者都不曾含有的第三种。

abstract.en: Picture a dozen cards sorted into piles, then read as one story.
abstract.cn: 想象十几张卡片分堆之后，被读成一个故事。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge built from two banks that never touch.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥由两岸搭起，而两岸从不接触。

examples.en: The report is a synthesis of five separate studies.
examples.cn: 这份报告是五项独立研究的综合。

examples.en: The laboratory completed the synthesis in a single afternoon.
examples.cn: 实验室在一个下午就完成了这次合成。

examples.en: Good synthesis needs disagreement as much as agreement.
examples.cn: 好的综合既需要共识，也同样需要分歧。

dict_mnemonic.text: syn（一起）+ thesis（放置）＝ 把分开的东西放到一起 → 综合、合成。

root: 希腊 synthesis「放到一起、组合」，由 syn-「一起」+ tithenai「放置」构成；该动词更早来源属重构形式，一般认为与拉丁 facere「做」、英语 do 同出。经拉丁进入英语。同族有 thesis、hypothesis、antithesis、synthetic。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one placement: parts set side by side until they hold as one. The parts can be ideas, chemicals, traditions, philosophical opposites, sources in an essay, phonemes in a voice, molecules in a cell, or pieces of knowledge in a learner's task.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次摆放展开：部分被并排放好，直到合为一体。这些部分可以是观念、化学品、传统、哲学上的对立面、文章里的来源、语音里的音素、细胞里的分子，或学习者任务中的知识碎片。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many pieces laid side by side until they read as one object.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多碎片并排摆好，直到被读成一件东西。

chain: A WHOLE THAT DID NOT EXIST

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE MADE THING: placing together, and the composite that now stands on its own.
branches.cn: 行为与成品：放到一起的动作，以及如今独立站立的综合体。

branches.en: MADE IN A FLASK, MADE IN A CELL: the same building of a compound at two scales.
branches.cn: 在烧瓶里造，在细胞里造：同一件构建化合物的事，两个尺度。

branches.en: THE OPPOSITE KEPT: philosophy asks the whole to preserve what was true on both sides.
branches.cn: 被保留的对立面：哲学要求整体保住两边各自为真的部分。

branches.en: ONE VOICE FROM MANY PARTS: sources welded into an argument, phonemes welded into speech.
branches.cn: 多部分合成一个声音：来源焊成论证，音素焊成语音。

branches.en: A NAMED STEP: education turns the act into a level that can be assessed.
branches.cn: 被命名的一步：教育把这个动作变成一个可被评定的层级。

intro.en: Synthesis is a Greek compound taken whole, and its two parts also build several other English words.
intro.cn: synthesis 是整体借入的希腊复合词，它的两部分还构成若干其他英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin passed the Greek noun on unchanged; the productive endings in English build the verb, the adjective and the device.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语原样传出这个希腊名词；英语里能产的词尾则造出动词、形容词与器具名。

items.example: The prefix gathers the parts into one place.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把各部分聚到一处。

items.example: The root is the hand setting something down.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根是把东西放下的那只手。

items.example: Synthesis came after the notes were grouped.
items.exampleCN: 笔记归类之后，综合才出现。

items.example: Chemists synthesize the compound in four steps.
items.exampleCN: 化学家用四步合成这种化合物。

items.meaning: a device or person that combines
items.exampleCN: 这间录音室有三台合成器。
这种维生素是以合成方式制出的。

items.meaning: able to be made by combining
items.example: The molecule is synthesizable in two steps.
items.exampleCN: 这个分子可用两步合成。

items.example: The same placing verb stands alone here.
items.exampleCN: 同一个「放置」动词在这里单独出现。

syntheticus, synthetice (adj., late Latin, from Greek)

definition_en: made by chemical processes rather than taken from nature
core_image: 实验室里的烧瓶被倒出透明纤维，织成一块布
scene: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
sceneCN: 这里 synthetic 是「合成的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这件外套用的是合成纤维。

senses.title: Made by chemical synthesis
senses.definition: produced by combining substances in a lab
senses.definitionCN: 在实验室中由物质组合而成
senses.example: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
senses.exampleCN: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。
senses.why: The Greek root means putting things together, so a lab-made material is one assembled from parts.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为把东西放在一起，因此实验室制造的材料是由部分组装而成。

senses.title: Not genuine in feeling
senses.definition: insincere, as if manufactured
senses.definitionCN: 不真诚的，仿佛人工制造
senses.example: He answered with a synthetic smile.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着假笑回答。
senses.why: If a material can be manufactured, so can an emotion that looks real but is not.
senses.whyCN: 材料可以制造，看起来真实却并非真实的情感也可以。

intro.en: Synthetic comes from Greek synthetikos, skilled at putting together.
intro.cn: synthetic 源自希腊语 synthetikos，意为善于组合。

items.en: Synthesis meant a putting together.
items.cn: synthesis 意为放在一起。

items.en: Tithenai meant to place.
items.cn: tithenai 意为放置。

items.en: Modern Latin syntheticus kept the combining sense.
items.cn: 近代拉丁语 syntheticus 保留组合之义。

items.en: Synthetic entered chemistry for lab-made compounds.
items.cn: synthetic 进入化学领域，指实验室制造的化合物。

items.en: Synthetic widened to anything artificial or insincere.
items.cn: synthetic 扩展到任何人工或虚假之物。

note.en: Synthetic is compared with look-alike words and with words for artificial things.
note.cn: 把 synthetic 与形近词以及表示人造的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Synthetic means assembled by human hands instead of grown by nature.
normalIntro.cn: synthetic 指由人手工合成，而非自然生长。

normal.en: This jacket is made of synthetic fibres.
normal.cn: 这件外套用的是合成纤维。

normal.en: Synthetic rubber replaced natural rubber in tyres.
normal.cn: 合成橡胶在轮胎中取代了天然橡胶。

normal.en: The fabric is cheap because it is synthetic.
normal.cn: 这种布料便宜，因为是合成的。

normal.en: He answered with a synthetic smile.
normal.cn: 他带着假笑回答。

normal.en: The drug is synthetic but effective.
normal.cn: 这种药是合成的，但很有效。

definition_en: a set of connected parts or rules working together
core_image: 地铁线路图上纵横交错的彩色线条汇成一个网络
scene: 这座城市的地铁系统非常方便。The city s metro system is very convenient.
sceneCN: 这里 system 是「系统」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这座城市的地铁系统非常方便。

senses.title: Connected parts working together
senses.definition: a group of parts that operate as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体运作的一组部件
senses.example: The city s metro system is very convenient.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的地铁系统非常方便。
senses.why: The Greek word meant an organized whole, which is exactly the modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个希腊词意为有组织的整体，正是现代的含义。

senses.title: An established set of rules
senses.definition: an organized set of rules or customs
senses.definitionCN: 一套有组织的规则或惯例
senses.example: The tax system favours small firms.
senses.exampleCN: 税制对小企业有利。
senses.why: Rules arranged into a working whole are a system in the same sense as machinery.
senses.whyCN: 规则被安排成运作的整体，与机械系统同理。

senses.title: An organized method
senses.definition: a planned way of doing something
senses.definitionCN: 有计划的行事方式
senses.example: She has a system for taking notes.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一套记笔记的方法。
senses.why: A personal routine can also be an organized whole, so the word covers method.
senses.whyCN: 个人习惯也能构成有组织的整体，因此这个词也指方法。

senses.title: The body as a whole
senses.definition: the body or one of its functional groups
senses.definitionCN: 身体或其中某个功能组
senses.example: Exercise strengthens the immune system.
senses.exampleCN: 锻炼增强免疫系统。
senses.why: The body is the most literal set of connected parts, so its groups are also systems.
senses.whyCN: 身体是最字面的相连部件集合，因此其各类功能组也叫系统。

items.en: System extended to rules, methods and the body.

abstract.en: We build systems, then systems build our days.

definition_zh: 系统的；有条理的；有计划的
definition_en: done according to a fixed plan or method
core_image: 实验台上每份样本都贴着编号标签，按顺序排开
scene: 他们做了一次系统的调查。They carried out a systematic survey.
sceneCN: 这里 systematic 是「系统的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他们做了一次系统的调查。

senses.title: Done by a fixed method
senses.definition: following an organized plan rather than chance
senses.definitionCN: 按有组织的计划而非随意进行
senses.example: They carried out a systematic survey.
senses.exampleCN: 他们做了一次系统的调查。
senses.why: The adjective turns system into a way of acting, so it names work done by ordered method.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词把系统变成行事方式，因此指按有序方法所做的工作。

senses.title: Regular and orderly in habit
senses.definition: keeping things in a neat, ordered way
senses.definitionCN: 把事物保持整齐有序
senses.example: She is systematic about filing receipts.
senses.exampleCN: 她整理收据很有条理。
senses.why: A person can embody a system too, which gives the sense of orderly habit.
senses.whyCN: 人也能体现系统，于是产生有条理习惯之义。

intro.en: Systematic is built on Greek systema, an organized whole.
intro.cn: systematic 建立在希腊语 systema（有组织的整体）之上。

items.en: Systema meant a whole arranged from parts.
items.cn: systema 意为由部分安排成的整体。

items.en: Systematikos meant skilled in arranging.
items.cn: systematikos 意为善于安排。

items.en: Modern Latin systematicus kept the arranging sense.

items.en: Systematic described work done by method.

items.en: Systematic extended to orderly personal habits.
items.cn: systematic 扩展到有条理的个人习惯。

note.en: Systematic is compared with look-alike words and with words for orderly work.
note.cn: 把 systematic 与形近词以及表示有序工作的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Systematic means letting a plan, not mood, decide the next step.
normalIntro.cn: systematic 指让计划而非心情决定下一步。

normal.en: They carried out a systematic survey.
normal.cn: 他们做了一次系统的调查。

abstract.en: To be systematic is to trust the next step more than the mood.

definition_en: a small round piece of medicine, a flat slab with writing on it, or a thin portable computer
core_image: 掌心大小的扁平薄片
scene: 医生把一片白色药片放在桌上，叮嘱她饭后服用。The doctor put a white tablet on the table and told her to take it after meals.
sceneCN: 这里 tablet 是「药片」（第 1 个义项）；句意：医生把一片白色药片放在桌上，叮嘱她饭后服用。

senses.title: A small round pill
senses.definition: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow
senses.definitionCN: 吞服的小圆片药物
senses.example: The doctor put a white tablet on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把一片白色药片放在桌上。
senses.why: A flat pressed disc of medicine keeps the shape of a small board.
senses.whyCN: 压制成型的小药片保留了「扁平一片」的形状，所以从木板转指药片。

senses.title: A flat slab with writing
senses.definition: a flat piece of stone or metal with words cut into it
senses.definitionCN: 刻有文字的扁平石板或金属板
senses.example: The names were cut into a stone tablet.
senses.exampleCN: 名字被刻在石碑上。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a flat board used for writing.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是用来书写的平板，石碑与牌匾都沿用了这块「平板」的形象。

senses.title: A thin portable computer
senses.definition: a thin flat computer that you control by touching the screen
senses.definitionCN: 靠触摸屏幕操作的薄型电脑
senses.example: She reads the news on her tablet every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上用平板电脑看新闻。
senses.why: The device is literally a flat slate you write and read on.
senses.whyCN: 这种设备本质上就是一块可读可写的扁平石板，于是沿用 tablet 这个名字。

intro.en: Tablet descends from Latin tabula, a board, through a small-board form.
intro.cn: tablet 经由「小板」这一指小形式，源自拉丁语 tabula（木板、书写板）。

items.en: Tabula meant a board or writing tablet.
items.cn: tabula 意为木板或书写板。

items.en: Tabella was the small form of tabula.
items.cn: tabella 是 tabula 的指小形式，意为小板。

items.en: Tablete named a small board.
items.cn: tablete 指小块板子。

items.en: Tablette kept the board sense.
items.cn: tablette 保留了「板」的含义。

items.en: Tablet extended to pills and flat computers.

note.en: Tablet is set beside look-alike words and beside words for pills and flat devices.

definition_en: to deal with a difficult problem, or to grab and stop an opponent in sport
core_image: 水手把缠成一团的绳索一根根理顺
scene: 甲板上的绳索缠成一团，水手们开始动手处理。The sailors began to tackle the ropes tangled on deck.
sceneCN: 这里 tackle 是「处理、对付」（第 1 个义项）；句意：水手们开始处理甲板上缠成一团的绳索。

senses.title: To deal with a problem
senses.definition: to make a determined effort to deal with something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 下决心应对困难的事情
senses.example: We must tackle the problem before it grows.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须在问题变大之前处理它。
senses.why: Gear was sorted and set in order before work began, so the verb came to mean setting to work.
senses.whyCN: 先把索具整理归位，再开工；于是这个词从「整理装备」引申为「着手处理」。

senses.title: To grab an opponent
senses.definition: to stop a player by taking hold of them and pulling them down
senses.definitionCN: 抓住对方球员并把他摔倒以阻止进攻
senses.example: The defender tackled the runner at the line.
senses.exampleCN: 防守队员在线上擒抱了跑卫。
senses.why: The physical grip on gear became a physical grip on a rival.
senses.whyCN: 对装备的用力抓握，转成了对对手的用力抓握。

senses.title: Equipment for a sport
senses.definition: the set of equipment used for an activity such as fishing
senses.definitionCN: 某项活动所用的成套装备，如钓具
senses.example: He packed his fishing tackle into the car.
senses.exampleCN: 他把钓具装进车里。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the gear itself.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「装备」本身，动词义由整理装备的动作发展而来。

intro.en: Tackle comes from sailing gear, borrowed from Low German.
intro.cn: tackle 来自航海的索具，借自低地德语。

items.en: Takel named the rigging of a ship.
items.cn: takel 指船上的索具。

items.en: Takel entered English as sailing gear.
items.cn: takel 进入英语，指航海装备。

items.en: Tackle meant to fit out a ship.
items.cn: tackle 表示给船装配索具。

items.en: It came to mean dealing with a task.
items.cn: 它转而表示着手处理任务。

items.en: Sport gave it the sense of grabbing a rival.
items.cn: 体育又赋予它擒抱对手的含义。

note.en: Tackle is compared with look-alike words and with verbs for handling difficulties.
note.cn: 把 tackle 与形近词以及表示应对困难的动词作对比。

branches.en: Sorting ropes becomes sorting problems.

definition_en: a small label fixed to something, or to fix such a label
core_image: 行李牌系在箱子的把手上
scene: 她把写有名字的行李牌系在箱子上。She tied a name tag to the handle of her suitcase.
sceneCN: 这里 tag 是「标签」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她把写有名字的行李牌系在行李箱把手上。

senses.title: A small attached label
senses.definition: a small piece of paper or plastic fixed to something to identify it
senses.definitionCN: 系在或贴在物品上用于识别的小纸片或塑料片
senses.example: She tied a name tag to the handle of her suitcase.
senses.exampleCN: 她把姓名牌系在行李箱把手上。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a hanging piece of cloth used as a mark.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是垂下来作记号的小布片，今天的标签沿用了这个「挂着的小片」形象。

senses.title: To mark with a label
senses.definition: to attach a label to something or mark it for identification
senses.definitionCN: 给某物贴上标签或加上标识
senses.example: The staff tagged every bag before loading.
senses.exampleCN: 工作人员在装车前给每个包贴上标签。
senses.why: The noun turned into the act of adding the label.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接转化为「加上标签」这个动作。

senses.title: A chasing playground game
senses.definition: a children's game in which one player chases and touches others
senses.definitionCN: 一名儿童追逐并触碰其他人的游戏
senses.example: The children played tag in the yard after school.
senses.exampleCN: 放学后孩子们在院子里玩捉人游戏。
senses.why: Touching a runner marks them, just as a tag marks an object.
senses.whyCN: 碰到跑动的人就算「标记」到他，和给物品贴标签是同一个比喻。

intro.en: Tag first meant a hanging scrap of cloth; its deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: tag 最早指垂下的碎布片，更深层的来源不确定。

items.en: Tagge meant a hanging piece of cloth.
items.cn: tagge 指垂下的布片。

items.en: The deeper root of tagge is not settled.
items.cn: tagge 的更早词源尚无定论。

items.en: A tag became a label for identification.
items.cn: tag 变成用于识别的标签。

items.en: The verb meant to fix a label.
items.cn: 动词义为贴上标签。

items.en: The playground game borrowed the touch-and-mark idea.
items.cn: 儿童游戏借用了「触碰即标记」的想法。

note.en: Tag is set beside look-alike words and beside words for labels.
note.cn: 把 tag 与形近词以及表示标签的词作对比。

abstract.en: Small cloth, lasting identity.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贴个」——把标签「贴个」在箱子上，一眼就认出是谁的行李。

root: 中古英语 tagge 指垂下的布片，词源不确定，一般认为与「悬挂的小片」这一形象有关。

sensesIntro.en: Tag runs from a hanging cloth mark to a label, the act of labelling, and a touching game.
sensesIntro.cn: tag 从垂下的布片标记，延伸到标签、贴标签的动作，以及触碰即算的儿童游戏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small cloth mark swinging from a handle.

branches.en: A label names what it hangs on.

branches.en: Touching a runner marks them.

branches.en: Noun and verb share one image.

branches.en: A price tag speaks without words.
branches.cn: 价签不必说话就传达了信息。

intro.en: Tag forms a small modern family through compounding.

definition_en: the part that sticks out at the back of an animal or object, or to follow someone secretly
core_image: 小狗摇着翘起的尾巴迎接主人
scene: 小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。The little dog wagged its tail as soon as its owner came home.
sceneCN: 这里 tail 是「尾巴」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。

senses.title: The back part of an animal
senses.definition: the long part that grows from the back of an animal
senses.definitionCN: 动物身体后部长出的部分
senses.example: The little dog wagged its tail as soon as its owner came home.
senses.exampleCN: 小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。
senses.why: The core sense is the moving appendage at the back.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项就是身体后部会摆动的那一条。

senses.title: The rear end of anything
senses.definition: the last or back part of an object, line, or period
senses.definitionCN: 物体、队伍或时段的最后部分
senses.example: The plane lifted its tail first.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机先抬起机尾。
senses.why: Anything with a front can be imagined with a tail at the back.
senses.whyCN: 凡有前端之物，都可以想象出一条位于后端的「尾巴」。

senses.title: To follow someone secretly
senses.definition: to follow a person quietly in order to watch where they go
senses.definitionCN: 悄悄跟在某人后面，看他去哪里
senses.example: A stranger tailed him through the market.
senses.exampleCN: 一个陌生人在市场里尾随他。
senses.why: To follow at the tail is to stay just behind like a tail.
senses.whyCN: 跟在「尾巴」的位置上，就是像尾巴一样紧贴身后。

intro.en: Tail is an Old English word that has kept its shape for a thousand years.
intro.cn: tail 是古英语词，一千年来词形几乎没变。

items.en: The root meant a hairy or hanging part.
items.cn: 词根意为毛茸茸或垂下的部分。

items.en: Tægl meant the tail of an animal.
items.cn: tægl 意为动物的尾巴。

items.en: The word shortened to tail.

items.en: Tail extended to the rear of objects.
items.cn: tail 扩展到物体的后部。

items.en: The verb came to mean following secretly.
items.cn: 动词义发展为秘密尾随。

note.en: Tail is compared with look-alike words and with words for following.
note.cn: 把 tail 与形近词以及表示跟随的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Tail is the part that trails behind and swings with the body.
normalIntro.cn: tail 是拖在身后、随身体摆动的那一部分。

abstract.en: To tail someone is to become their shadow.
abstract.cn: 尾随某人，就是变成他的影子。

abstract.en: The back end tells where a thing has been.
abstract.cn: 末端记录着一件事走过的路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「忒儿」——狗尾巴一甩就发出「忒儿」的轻响，记住它是身后那一条。

root: 古英语 tægl（动物的尾巴），源自日耳曼语，词形历经中古英语缩短为 tail。

sensesIntro.en: Tail starts as an animal part and spreads to the rear of things and the act of following.
sensesIntro.cn: tail 从动物身体的一部分，扩展到物体的后部，以及跟随的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a swinging appendage at the back of a body.
core.cn: 核心意象：长在身体后部、会摆动的附肢。

branches.en: The animal part is the anchor.
branches.cn: 动物的尾巴是整个词义的锚点。

branches.en: Objects borrow the rear position.
branches.cn: 物体借用了「后端」的位置。

branches.en: Following mimics being a tail.
branches.cn: 尾随就是模仿尾巴的位置。

branches.en: Both point to the back.
branches.cn: 两者都指向后方。

branches.en: The last part of time also has a tail.
branches.cn: 时间段的最后一段也有「尾巴」。

intro.en: Tail builds compounds such as tailwind and taillight.
intro.cn: tail 能构成 tailwind、taillight 等复合词。

latinIntro.en: Tail is Germanic; Latin cauda, tail, appears in caudate and caudal.

definition_en: a natural ability to do something well, or people who have such ability
core_image: 天平一端称出沉甸甸的分量
scene: 教练一眼就看出这个少年身上有天赋。The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
sceneCN: 这里 talent 是「天赋、才能」（第 1 个义项）；句意：教练一眼就看出这个少年身上有天赋。

senses.title: A natural ability
senses.definition: a natural ability to do something well
senses.definitionCN: 把某件事做好的天生能力
senses.example: The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
senses.exampleCN: 教练一眼就看出这个少年有天赋。
senses.why: A talent was once a weighed amount of metal, so ability was pictured as something measured out.
senses.whyCN: talent 原指称量出的一笔金属，于是才能被想象成天生「分到」的分量。

senses.title: People with ability
senses.definition: people who are good at something, considered as a group
senses.definitionCN: 被作为一个群体看待的有才干的人
senses.example: The company is looking for young talent.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司在寻找年轻人才。
senses.why: The ability was transferred to the people who carry it.
senses.whyCN: 「才能」这一抽象物被转移到拥有它的人身上。

intro.en: Talent began as a unit of weight and value before it meant a gift.
intro.cn: talent 最初是重量与价值的单位，后来才表示天赋。

items.en: Talanton meant a balance and a weighed sum.
items.cn: talanton 意为天平与称出的数额。

items.en: Talentum kept the sense of a weight of money.
items.cn: talentum 保留了「一笔重量的钱」之义。

items.en: Talenta appeared in biblical parables of entrusted money.
items.cn: talenta 出现在受托钱财的圣经比喻中。

items.en: Talent came to mean a God-given ability.
items.cn: talent 转而表示上天赋予的能力。

items.en: It now means natural ability and able people.
items.cn: 现代英语中指天赋与有才能的人。

note.en: Talent is compared with look-alike forms and with words for ability.
note.cn: 把 talent 与形近形式以及表示能力的词作对比。

normalIntro.cn: talent 记着一架天平，曾像称银子一样称出才能。

normal.en: The boy had talent for music.
normal.cn: 这个男孩有音乐天赋。

normal.en: The company is looking for young talent.

normal.en: Natural talent still needs daily practice.

normal.en: The team is full of talent this season.
normal.cn: 这支队伍本赛季人才济济。

abstract.en: Ability arrives as if weighed and handed over.
abstract.cn: 才能仿佛被称量好再交到手里。

abstract.en: A scale became a gift.
abstract.cn: 一架天平变成了礼物。

abstract.en: What is measured out can still grow.
abstract.cn: 被分到的分量仍能继续增长。

examples.en: The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.

examples.en: The company is looking for young talent.
examples.cn: 这家公司在寻找年轻人才。

examples.en: Natural talent still needs daily practice.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太能」——「太能」干的人，就是身上有天赋的人。

root: 希腊语 talanton（天平、称出的重量）经拉丁语 talentum 进入英语，由「一笔钱财」转为「天赋」。

sensesIntro.en: From a weighed sum of money, talent moved to an inborn ability and then to able people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从称出的一笔钱，talent 转向天生的能力，再转向有才能的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pair of scales weighing out a share.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架天平称出一份分量。

branches.en: Ability inherits the image of a measured share.
branches.cn: 才能继承了「分得的一份」这一形象。

branches.en: The gift stands for the gifted.
branches.cn: 「天赋」转指拥有天赋的人。

branches.en: One word holds both the gift and its bearers.
branches.cn: 一个词同时容纳天赋与拥有者。

branches.en: The scale suggests something given, not earned.
branches.cn: 天平暗示才能是被赋予而非赚来的。

branches.en: A pool of talent is a pool of people.
branches.cn: 人才储备就是一群人的储备。

intro.en: Talent has a tight family of adjectives and a vivid root history.
intro.cn: talent 有一个紧凑的形容词词族和生动的词根史。

latinIntro.en: Latin talentum, from Greek talanton, means a balance and a weighed sum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 talentum（源自希腊语 talanton）意为天平与称出的数额。

items.exampleCN: 这个角色并非没有才能。

items.example: Talentum meant a sum of money.

definition_en: to hit something lightly, a device controlling water flow, or to make use of a resource
core_image: 指尖在桌面上轻轻敲三下
scene: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。Someone tapped gently on the car window to remind him the light was green.
sceneCN: 这里 tap 是「轻敲」（第 1 个义项）；句意：有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。

senses.title: To hit lightly
senses.definition: to strike something gently with the fingers or a small object
senses.definitionCN: 用手指或小物件轻轻击打
senses.example: Someone tapped gently on the car window.
senses.exampleCN: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗。
senses.why: The sound of a light blow is the oldest core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 轻击发出的声音是这个词最古老的内核。

senses.title: A device for running water
senses.definition: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe
senses.definitionCN: 控制管道中水流大小的装置
senses.example: The tap in the kitchen kept dripping all night.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房的水龙头整夜滴水。
senses.why: A faucet was once a plug struck or turned to release water.
senses.whyCN: 水龙头最初就是被敲开或拧开的塞子，动作延伸成了器具。

senses.title: To make use of a resource
senses.definition: to make use of something that is available
senses.definitionCN: 把已有的资源拿出来使用
senses.example: The company tapped into a young market.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司开发了一个年轻的市场。
senses.why: Opening a tap lets stored water flow, just as a resource is opened for use.
senses.whyCN: 打开龙头让存水流出，正如把资源打开来使用。

intro.en: Tap began as the sound and act of a light blow, then named a water outlet.
intro.cn: tap 最初是轻击的声音与动作，后来指水的出口。

items.en: Tappen meant to strike lightly.
items.cn: tappen 意为轻敲。

items.en: Tap named the strike and its sound.
items.cn: tap 指轻击及其声音。

items.en: A tap became a spout for water.
items.cn: tap 又指放水的龙头。

items.en: Tapping a line meant listening secretly.
items.cn: 在线上「搭一下」就是秘密窃听。

items.en: To tap a resource is to open it for use.
items.cn: 开发资源就是把它打开使用。

note.en: Tap is compared with look-alike words and with words for knocking and faucets.
note.cn: 把 tap 与形近词以及表示敲击和水龙头的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Tap is a small sound, a small turn of a handle, and a resource let loose.
normalIntro.cn: tap 是轻轻一声、轻轻一拧，也是让资源流出来。

normal.en: Someone tapped gently on the car window.
normal.cn: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗。

normal.en: The kitchen tap kept dripping.
normal.cn: 厨房水龙头一直在滴水。

normal.en: The company tapped into a young market.
normal.cn: 这家公司开发了一个年轻的市场。

normal.en: He tapped the keys twice.
normal.cn: 他轻敲了两下键盘。

normal.en: Tap water is safe to drink here.
normal.cn: 这里的自来水可以直接喝。

abstract.en: A light touch opens a heavy flow.

abstract.en: Tapping is asking for attention in sound.

abstract.en: Every resource waits behind a tap.
abstract.cn: 每份资源都等在某个龙头后面。

examples.en: Someone tapped gently on the car window to remind him the light was green.
examples.cn: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。

examples.en: The tap in the kitchen kept dripping all night.
examples.cn: 厨房的水龙头整夜滴水。

examples.en: The company tapped into a young market.
examples.cn: 这家公司开发了一个年轻的市场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踏普」——脚尖「踏」着地打拍子，一下一下，就是轻敲。

root: 中古英语 tappen（轻击），拟声来源；由轻击动作引申出水龙头与「开发资源」。

sensesIntro.en: Tap grows from a light blow to a water outlet to the opening of any resource.
sensesIntro.cn: tap 从轻击长出水龙头，又长出「打开资源」的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fingertips striking a surface three times.
core.cn: 核心意象：指尖在表面上敲三下。

branches.en: The light blow is the source sense.
branches.cn: 轻击是源义项。

branches.en: The outlet releases what is stored.
branches.cn: 龙头释放储存之物。

branches.en: Resources flow like water.
branches.cn: 资源像水一样流出。

branches.en: Both are about opening a flow.
branches.cn: 两者都关于打开流动。

branches.en: Even a phone tap begins with a light touch.
branches.cn: 连电话窃听也始于轻轻一接。

intro.en: Tap builds a small family of agents and actions.
intro.cn: tap 构成由施动者与动作组成的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Tap is likely imitative in origin; Latin tangere, to touch, is only a semantic echo.

definition_zh: 胶带；磁带；用胶带粘；录制
definition_en: a long thin strip that sticks, a magnetic strip for sound, or to record something
core_image: 一条透明胶带贴在纸箱接缝上
scene: 她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。She sealed the seam of the box with tape.
sceneCN: 这里 tape 是「胶带」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。

senses.title: A sticky strip
senses.definition: a long narrow strip with glue on one side
senses.definitionCN: 一面涂有黏胶的细长条
senses.example: She sealed the seam of the box with tape.
senses.exampleCN: 她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a narrow woven strip, which later carried glue.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是窄窄的织带，后来这种带上涂了胶。

senses.title: A magnetic recording strip
senses.definition: a long plastic strip coated to store sound or images
senses.definitionCN: 涂有磁性材料、可存储声音或影像的长条
senses.example: The old tape still plays in his car.
senses.exampleCN: 那盘旧磁带还能在他的车里播放。
senses.why: A thin strip became the carrier of recorded sound.
senses.whyCN: 细长的带子变成录制声音的载体。

senses.title: To stick with tape
senses.definition: to fix something in place with sticky tape
senses.definitionCN: 用黏胶带把东西固定住
senses.example: He taped the note to the door.
senses.exampleCN: 他用胶带把便条贴在门上。
senses.why: The noun turned into the act of applying it.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接转化为「贴上胶带」的动作。

senses.title: To record sound or pictures
senses.definition: to record something on tape or a digital medium
senses.definitionCN: 把声音或画面录制下来
senses.example: They taped the interview for the radio.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为电台录制了这次采访。
senses.why: Recording put sound onto the moving strip, so the strip gave its name to the act.
senses.whyCN: 录制是把声音存到移动的带子上，于是带名成了动作名。

intro.cn: tape 最初指窄织带，远早于胶与录音。

items.en: Tæppe meant a narrow strip of cloth.

items.en: Tape kept the sense of a thin band.

items.en: Magnetic tape carried recorded sound.

items.en: The verb means to stick or to record.

definition_en: an object aimed at, a goal, or to make something the aim of an action
core_image: 箭簇正插在靶心的红圈里
scene: 第一支箭就射中了靶子的中心。The first arrow hit the centre of the target.
sceneCN: 这里 target 是「靶子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：第一支箭就射中了靶子的中心。

senses.title: A mark to shoot at
senses.definition: a board or object marked with rings for shooting at
senses.definitionCN: 画有圆环、供射击的板或物
senses.example: The first arrow hit the centre of the target.
senses.exampleCN: 第一支箭就射中了靶子的中心。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the small round shield used for practice.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是练习用的小圆盾，靶子由此而来。

senses.title: A goal to reach

senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体想要达到的结果
senses.example: The team met its sales target this year.
senses.exampleCN: 团队今年完成了销售目标。
senses.why: A goal is a target you shoot at with effort rather than an arrow.
senses.whyCN: 目标就是你用努力而非箭去射的那个靶。

senses.title: To aim at something
senses.definition: to direct an action or effort toward a particular group or thing
senses.definitionCN: 把行动或精力对准某个群体或事物
senses.example: The campaign targets young voters.
senses.exampleCN: 这场活动针对年轻选民。
senses.why: The noun turned into the act of aiming.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了「瞄准」这个动作。

definition_zh: 关税；税率表；（公用事业）价目表
definition_en: a tax on goods entering a country, a published table of such rates, or a schedule of charges for a service
core_image: 海关窗口上贴着一张长表，每一行写着一种货物与一个百分比，关员用笔在表上划线
scene: 海关窗口上贴着一张长表，每一行写着一种货物与一个百分比，关员用笔在表上划线。The government raised the tariff on imported steel.
sceneCN: 这里这个词指「对进口货物征收的税」（第 1 个义项：进口关税）；句意为政府对进口钢材提高了关税。图中可辨识物件：长表、货物名称、百分比、关员的笔。

pos.zh: 关税；税率表；（水、电、通信的）价目表
对……征收关税；按价目表收费（较少用）

derivatives.zh: 制定税率；按价目表收费

senses.title: A tax on imported goods
senses.definition: a charge collected at the border on goods coming into a country
senses.definitionCN: 在边境对进入一国的货物收取的费用
senses.example: The tariff on imported steel doubled overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 进口钢材的关税一夜之间翻了一倍。
senses.why: The word came to mean a published list of charges, and the charge for imports became its central sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本指一份公布的收费表，而对进口的收费成了它最核心的义项。

senses.title: The published schedule of rates
senses.definition: the official table that lists each kind of goods and the rate charged on it
senses.definitionCN: 列出各类货物及所征税率的官方表格
senses.example: The customs office keeps the tariff in a thick bound volume.
senses.exampleCN: 海关把税则保存在一本厚厚的大册里。
senses.why: A tax needs a table before it can be collected, and the table shares the name.
senses.whyCN: 税在征收之前需要一张表，这张表便与税共用同一个名字。

senses.title: A protective tariff
senses.definition: a duty set high enough to shield domestic producers from foreign competition
senses.definitionCN: 高到足以让本国生产者免受外国竞争冲击的关税
senses.example: The protective tariff kept the local mills open for a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 保护性关税让本地磨坊多开了十年。
senses.why: A toll can be set not to raise money but to keep traffic out.
senses.whyCN: 一道收费门可以不为收钱，而为把车流挡在外面。

senses.title: A retaliatory tariff
senses.definition: a duty imposed in answer to another country's duty
senses.definitionCN: 为回应另一国的关税而施加的关税
senses.example: The retaliatory tariff hit fruit from the neighbouring market.
senses.exampleCN: 报复性关税打击了邻国市场的水果。
senses.why: When a toll is charged against you, the answer is another toll.
senses.whyCN: 当别人对你收过路费，回答就是再收一道。

senses.title: The rate itself, whether by value or by unit
senses.titleCN: 税率本身，按价值或按数量计
senses.definition: the percentage of value or the fixed sum per unit that the duty amounts to
senses.definitionCN: 关税所折算成的价值百分比或每单位固定金额
senses.example: The tariff rate is charged on the value stated on the invoice.
senses.exampleCN: 税率按发票上申报的价值征收。
senses.why: Behind the table sits a number, and that number is what officials actually apply.
senses.whyCN: 表格背后是一个数字，官员实际适用的正是那个数字。

senses.title: A utility's schedule of charges
senses.definition: the published list of rates for electricity, gas, water or telephone service
senses.definitionCN: 电力、燃气、水或电话服务公布的费率表
senses.example: The night tariff makes off-peak power cheaper.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间电价表让非高峰用电更便宜。
senses.why: The same word for a published rate table serves any service that bills by a schedule.
senses.whyCN: 同一个表示公布费率表的词，适用于任何按表计费的服务。

senses.title: A tariff war between countries
senses.definition: a cycle in which each side raises duties in response to the other
senses.definitionCN: 双方互相提高关税以回应对方的循环
senses.example: The tariff war raised prices on both sides of the border.
senses.exampleCN: 关税战抬高了两国边境两侧的价格。
senses.why: Repeated retaliation turns a single duty into a sustained conflict.
senses.whyCN: 反复报复把单项关税变成持续冲突。

senses.title: A general price list or fee schedule
senses.titleCN: 一般的价目表或收费表
senses.definition: any table of charges, as for a hotel, a taxi service or a repair shop
senses.definitionCN: 任何收费表，如旅馆、出租车或修理店的价目表
senses.example: The hotel keeps its tariff on a card behind the door.
senses.exampleCN: 旅馆把价目表放在门后的卡片上。
senses.why: This is the oldest surviving sense: a list of prices printed to be read.
senses.whyCN: 这是留存下来的最早义项：一份印出来供人查看的价格清单。

intro.en: Tariff came into English through Italian and French from Arabic tarif, a notification or an assessment, from the verb meaning to know. The sense of a duty grew out of the published list of charges.
intro.cn: tariff 经意大利语与法语进入英语，来自阿拉伯语中表示「通告、估定」的词，其动词意为「知道」。关税义由公布的收费表发展而来。

items.en: The verb meant to know or to inform, and from it came the noun for a notification or an assessment.
items.cn: 这个动词意为「知道、告知」，由其产生表示「通告、估定」的名词。

items.en: Tarif named a statement of charges or a list of prices, the sense that travelled into Europe.
items.cn: tarif 指一份收费说明或价格清单，这一义项传入欧洲。

items.en: Italian tariffa kept the sense of a schedule of charges, used in ports and customs houses.
items.cn: 意大利语 tariffa 保留「收费表」之义，用于港口与海关。

items.en: French tarif carried the word onward, and English borrowed it in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 法语 tarif 继续传递这个词，英语在十六世纪借入。

items.en: In English the word first meant a table of rates, then the duty charged according to that table.
items.cn: 在英语中，这个词先指费率表，后指按该表征收的税。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries gas, water and telephone companies published their own tariffs, keeping the older list sense alive.
items.cn: 十九与二十世纪，燃气、水与电话公司各自公布价目表，使较旧的「清单」义得以延续。

note.en: The first group holds the word and two look-alikes, one of them unrelated in origin; the second holds other charges and the words closest in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是这个单词与两个形近词，其中一个来源无关；第二组是其他收费与最接近的同义词。

entries.definition: Subjected to a tariff; it describes goods or trade rather than the tax itself.
entries.definitionCN: 被征收关税的；它描述货物或贸易，而非税本身。

entries.definition: The act of setting rates or charging according to a schedule, used in regulation and utilities.
entries.definitionCN: 制定费率或按价目表收费的行为，用于监管与公用事业。

entries.definition: The movement of vehicles or goods, from Italian traffico; it looks close to tariff but comes from another word entirely.
entries.definitionCN: 车辆或货物的流动，来自意大利语 traffico；它与 tariff 拼写相近，来源却完全不同。

entries.definition: Free of tariffs; it is a derived adjective, not the tax.
entries.definitionCN: 无关税的；它是派生形容词，不是税本身。

entries.definition: A tax on imports or exports; it is close to tariff but can also mean an obligation.
entries.definitionCN: 对进出口征收的税；与 tariff 接近，但也指义务。

entries.definition: A charge imposed by authority, or the act of imposing it; broader than a border tax.
entries.definitionCN: 当局征收的费用，或征收这一行为；比边境税更宽。

entries.definition: A charge for using a road or a bridge; historically the same idea as a tariff but for traffic.
entries.definitionCN: 使用道路或桥梁所付的费用；历史上与关税同一思路，只是针对通行。

entries.definition: The amount charged per unit; a tariff is a table of such rates.
entries.definitionCN: 每单位收取的金额；关税就是这类费率构成的表。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real parts, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The word first meant a published list of charges, and a duty is one line in that list.
normal.cn: 这个词最初指公布的收费表，而关税就是表上的一行。

normal.en: The family runs tariff, tariffed, tariffing and tariffless.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 tariff、tariffed、tariffing 与 tariffless。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the border and the utility: import tariff, tariff rate, night tariff.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出边境与公用事业两面：进口关税、税率、夜间电价。

normal.en: Keep tariff and traffic apart: one is a table of charges, the other is movement.
normal.cn: 把关税与交通分开：一个是收费表，一个是流动。

normal.en: A customs officer with a pen on a long table is the picture of the whole word.
normal.cn: 一名关员拿着笔在长表上划线，就是这个词的整体画面。

abstract.en: Picture a menu of charges posted at a border, where each dish is a kind of goods.
abstract.cn: 想象边境上贴着一份收费菜单，每道菜就是一种货物。

abstract.en: Picture two countries each raising a wall one brick higher than the other's.
abstract.cn: 想象两个国家各自把墙砌得比对方高一块砖。

abstract.en: Picture a household meter read at night, with a cheaper column waiting for dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只家用表在夜里被抄读，表上有一栏更便宜的费率等着天黑。

examples.en: The tariff applies to the stated value of each shipment.
examples.cn: 关税按每批货运申报的价值征收。

examples.en: Farmers asked for a protective tariff on imported grain.
examples.cn: 农民要求对进口谷物征收保护性关税。

examples.en: The utility publishes a separate tariff for night use.
examples.cn: 这家公用事业单位另行公布夜间使用的价目表。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抬（ta）里（rif）夫」——边境照着费率表抬价收钱 → 关税、税率表

root: 来自阿拉伯语 tarif「通告、估定的收费」，经意大利语 tariffa 与法语 tarif 进入英语；本义是公布的收费表，后指按表征收的关税。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one published table: a duty on imports, the table itself, a protective duty, a retaliatory duty, the rate applied, a utility schedule, a war of duties, and any printed price list.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一张公布的表格展开：进口关税、表格本身、保护性关税、报复性关税、实际适用的税率、公用事业价目表、关税战，以及任何印出的价目表。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long rate table pinned at a customs window, with a pen tracing one line.
core.cn: 核心意象：海关窗口上钉着一张长费率表，一支笔正划过其中一行。

branches.en: THE LINE AND THE LIST: a single duty and the whole table are the same page at two scales.
branches.cn: 一行与整表：单项关税与整张表是同一页纸的两个尺度。

branches.en: A WALL OF PRICE: a protective duty is set to keep goods out rather than to raise money.
branches.cn: 价格的墙：保护性关税是要把货物挡在外面，而不是为了收钱。

branches.en: ANSWER AND ESCALATION: one retaliatory duty repeated becomes a tariff war.
branches.cn: 回应与升级：一项报复性关税反复出现，就成了关税战。

branches.en: THE NUMBER UNDER THE LINE: the rate is what an officer actually applies.
branches.cn: 行下的数字：税率才是关员实际执行的东西。

branches.en: BILLS AND MENUS: a utility schedule and a printed price list keep the oldest sense alive.
branches.cn: 账单与菜单：公用事业价目表与印出的价格清单保留了最古老的义项。

intro.en: The word is a single Arabic loan that passed through Italian and French; it has no Latin root, so its parts are best read as the borrowed stem plus English endings.
intro.cn: 这个词是一个经意大利语与法语传来的阿拉伯语借词，没有拉丁词根，因此各部分宜读作「借入的词干」加英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root is involved; the source is Arabic, so the Latin entries stay empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里不涉及拉丁词根；来源是阿拉伯语，因此拉丁语词形一栏留空。

items.example: The list of charges travelled from port to port.
items.exampleCN: 这份收费清单从一个港口传到另一个港口。

items.example: The harbour kept a tariffa for every cargo.
items.exampleCN: 港口为每种货物备有一份费率表。

items.meaning: a duty; a table of rates
items.example: The tariff lists every kind of goods.

items.exampleCN: 被征关税的货物清关更慢。

items.example: Tariffing the network took a full year.
items.exampleCN: 为网络制定费率花了整整一年。

items.example: The two neighbours trade tariffless goods.
items.exampleCN: 这两个邻国互相交易无关税的货物。

items.example: Duty is paid at the border.

items.structure: Old French costume, from Latin consuetudo (habit)
items.meaning: the office that collects border duties
items.exampleCN: 海关核查每一笔申报价值。

items.example: Each line of the table is a rate.
items.exampleCN: 表上的每一行都是一个费率。

definition_zh: 任务；工作；使承担艰巨任务
definition_en: a piece of work that must be done, or to give someone a difficult job
core_image: 桌上摊开的清单上划掉一项工作
scene: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。The teacher gave each group a task.
sceneCN: 这里 task 是「任务」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。

senses.title: A piece of work
senses.definition: a piece of work that has to be done
senses.definitionCN: 必须完成的一项工作
senses.example: The teacher gave each group a task.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给每个小组布置了一项任务。
senses.why: The word came from a tax or duty imposed on someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原指摊派到某人身上的税或义务。

senses.title: To give someone a job
senses.definition: to give someone a particular job to do
senses.definitionCN: 把某项工作交给某人去完成
senses.example: The manager tasked her with writing the report.
senses.exampleCN: 经理把写报告的任务交给了她。
senses.why: A task is laid on a person, so the verb means laying the duty down.
senses.whyCN: 任务是被「压」到人身上的，因此动词表示把责任派下去。

intro.en: Task came from a word for a tax or duty laid on people.
intro.cn: task 源自表示「摊派的税与义务」的词。

items.en: Tasca meant a tax or duty.
items.cn: tasca 意为税或义务。

items.en: Tasque carried the sense of an imposed duty.
items.cn: tasque 表示被摊派的义务。

items.en: Task meant a piece of required work.
items.cn: task 意为必须完成的工作。

items.en: Task lost the tax sense and kept the work sense.
items.cn: task 舍弃税务义，保留工作义。

items.en: The verb means to assign work.
items.cn: 动词义为分派工作。

note.en: Task is compared with look-alike words and with words for work.
note.cn: 把 task 与形近词以及表示工作的词作对比。
